Title: POST /user with CRLF payload does not inject response headers
Preconditions:
1. Access to API Base URL (https://petstore.swagger.io).
2. HTTP client available (Postman, curl, HTTPie, etc.).
3. Content-Type: application/json for POST/PUT requests.
Steps:
1. POST /v2/user with a body containing raw CRLF sequences inside string fields:
   username: "evil\r\nSet-Cookie: hacked=1"
   firstName: "evil\r\nX-Injected: 1"
2. Inspect the response status and headers.
Expected Results:
2. Response status is <500 (not a server crash).
2. Response headers do NOT contain "set-cookie: hacked=1".
2. Response headers do NOT contain any "x-injected" header (attacker cannot smuggle response headers via user input).
